title: A reversible change with no effect on services
paragraphs: EasyRMM will change one setting on this computer. It does not stop a service or change who can sign in.
The old value is kept, so the change can be undone from this queue while the record of it is on the computer.
The setting is read again after the change. If it is not as intended, EasyRMM puts the old value back and marks the item as failed.
undoNote: Undo puts back the value the computer had before.
